description: A very short pulse rung through a resonant highpass filter, in the manner of the 808 rimshot

params.text: Sets the corner of the filter the pulse rings, 200Hz to 2000Hz, which is the pitch you hear
Sets the resonance of that filter, from 1 fully anticlockwise to 10 fully clockwise, so the ring grows longer and more tonal as it rises
Fires the pulse; a rising edge at the trigger jack does it too

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.5V fires the sound; the length of the gate makes no difference

notes: a CV input is bipolar and is added to its knob: 10V there is worth the knob's whole travel, -10V cancels a knob that is fully up, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
the exciting pulse is 0.084ms of 5V and nothing on the panel changes it; everything you hear is the filter ringing
the filter is a highpass, despite the manual calling it a bandpass

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
